integrity: The symbolic proof gives the general assertion. The included standalone finite checker is supplemental and does not establish infinite generality.
scientific_limitations: Finite abelian kernels and fixed-point-free cyclic complements of order at least three only. Historical priority remains subject to older permutation-quandle literature; self-review is not independent validation.
title: Medial conjugation quotients of cyclic Frobenius groups: automorphisms and an infinite collision family
